name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::pop_back
intro:
Removes the last character from the string.

Equivalent to erase(end() - 1). The behavior is undefined if the string is empty.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In libstdc++, pop_back() is not available in C++98 mode.

summary: Removes the last character from the string.
